b092.name: the 5-HTP stop signs, first try (the point first)
b092.text: Side effects / stop signs: The big one to watch out for is agitation + sweating + diarrhea + tremor/clonus + fever, confusion, fast heart rate, or unstable blood pressure. Stop immediately if you get that, since it can be a sign of serotonin toxicity, which can become dangerous. Other stop signs include nausea, stomach discomfort, loose stools, headache, vivid or intense dreams, insomnia, sweating, tremor, anxiety, irritability, emotional agitation, or a too-bright / hypomanic feeling.
b092.why: the point first (E357): the dangerous pattern and why it matters to stop, then the other stop signs in his Y-85 shape ("Other stop signs include"); his symptom lists kept whole (E336: the protocol's required lists stay)

b093.name: the 5-HTP hard interaction rule, first try (the point first)
b093.text: Hard interaction rule: Don't mix 5-HTP casually with other serotonin-raising drugs or supplements, as serotonin syndrome is most often a multi-drug / stack problem. There's case literature and clinical reviews warning about that risk when 5-HTP is combined with antidepressants or MAOIs (see this dietary supplement interaction case report). MedlinePlus also has a general overview of serotonin syndrome. If you're doing psychedelics, avoid 5-HTP on your psychedelic days, and be especially strict around ayahuasca / harmala MAOI chemistry and iboga / ibogaine.
